status: Agent recommendation. Core incentive and Base target are user-directed; these specific parameters are not yet user-approved.
objective: Early exits fund patient holders. All reward liabilities remain funded by received assets.

token.standard: ERC-20 with explicitly non-standard transfer fees
token.minting: One genesis mint; no subsequent inflation
token.initial_allocation: All token supply allocated to initial public liquidity via a single-use launch escrow; seed WETH is a separate launch input. No presale or team token allocation in this proposed design.

fees.calculation: Compute tax on each consumed age cohort; sum fee amounts. Token atomic-unit rounding is retained explicitly.
fees.exit_definition: A positive transfer out of an ordinary holder address to another address, including a sale, gift, own-wallet move or unregistered pool. Zero transfers and self-transfers are no-ops for fees and age.
fees.tax_order: Most recent cohorts consumed first; fully mature inventory is consumed last.
fees.canonical_pair: One fixed, verified v2-style PI/WETH pair using fee-on-transfer-compatible routes. Pair output incurs the 3% buy fee. No v3 compatibility claim.
fees.exceptions: Only narrowly defined internal processing and initial-liquidity operations. No fee-exempt EOAs or arbitrary forwarding/rescue route for protected assets.
fees.additional_costs: AMM fees, network gas and price impact are separate from token taxes.

age_accounting.timing: Every maturity threshold takes at least its stated number of 24-hour days, and up to just under one extra day. Exact tier-change timestamps must be displayed.
age_accounting.topups: Only the new net receipt enters a fresh cohort. Existing cohorts and earned WETH stay intact.
age_accounting.transfers: Sender pays the applicable exit fee; recipient net tokens start a new age. Age is never forwarded.
age_accounting.state_bound: At most 31 active daily cohorts plus one mature balance per wallet. All cohorts older than 30 earned days share identical final rules and merge lazily.
age_accounting.lookup_bound: No iteration over the holder population; at most 31 cohorts per touched wallet, plus global cohort maintenance.

rewards.asset: WETH on Base. Claim may unwrap to native ETH; WETH remains a fallback for recipients that reject ETH.
rewards.formula: R_i = received_WETH_reward_pool * sum(balance_i_cohort * cohort_multiplier) / sum(all_eligible_balance_cohort * cohort_multiplier)
rewards.eligibility: Warm-up cohorts, canonical AMM, fee processor, token escrow, reward vault, launch escrow, operations vault and burn addresses are excluded.
rewards.ownership_timing: WETH allocations belong to the eligible balances at the settled funding event. Being present when a tax was collected does not create an earlier native-asset entitlement.
rewards.settlement: Target hourly permissionless fee processing, subject to collected fees, conservative swap bounds and execution. The contract does not wake itself. Pending tax inventory and last settlement are visible.
rewards.withdrawal: Earned WETH can be claimed at any time. Claiming or selling does not erase previously credited rewards. No expiry, auto-compounding or fixed APY.
rewards.payout_automation: Optional bounded claim-for batches pay the recorded beneficiary. Users retain direct claims; automatic hourly pushes to every wallet are not promised.
rewards.empty_eligibility: Assets stay in an unallocated reserve and are included when eligible weight exists. The operator cannot withdraw them.
rewards.rounding: High-precision cumulative indices, persistent per-account fractional remainders, and a recycled rounding reserve. All rounding must remain in the conservation equation.
rewards.implementation: Global cohort reward indices and a mature-cohort index. Save final cohort indices and merge-index references so inactive wallets can settle old rewards without a trusted Merkle publisher.

tax_allocation.scope: Percentages of collected token fees, not percentages of trade value.
tax_allocation.processing: Retain 5% of fee tokens for the token side of liquidity. Swap 95% within bounds; allocate actual WETH output in ratios 85:5:5 to rewards, liquidity quote side and operations. Use the retained tokens and liquidity WETH to add liquidity; unused liquidity assets carry forward.
tax_allocation.lp_custody: Initial and protocol-added LP positions are permanently locked under a verifiable immutable arrangement.
tax_allocation.operations_custody: Only the explicit 5% allocation goes to a disclosed operations treasury. Its multisig can spend that treasury, not holder rewards or locked liquidity. This is a protocol fee, not a claim that all fees return to participants.
tax_allocation.supply_effect: Fees transfer existing tokens. No token mint, rebase or promise of price support.

controls.token: Fixed supply and immutable fee bounds, maturation rules and canonical-pair identity after one-time initialization. No arbitrary blacklist or owner ability to raise exit fees.
controls.rewards: No admin withdrawal of reward assets; claims independently available if the keeper stops.
controls.processing: Fee processing can fail or pause without blocking ordinary sells or transfers. The liquidity pool can still have economic slippage; this is not an exit-price guarantee.
controls.swaps: Bound batch sizes, deadlines, minimum received amounts and price impact; validate manipulation resistance against the selected pool. Do not swap the full treasury blindly on every trade.

scope_limits: The token can enforce underlying-token movements. It cannot observe CEX internal trades, wrapper-share trades, or sale of a wallet/key. Do not advertise globally unavoidable taxes on every change of economic ownership.
An unregistered pool may incur exit tax on both legs and is not a supported trading route.
The multiplier redistributes a finite pool. It does not multiply aggregate yield. Volume and token price are market outcomes, not contract guarantees.
The daily-epoch compromise is deliberate. Exact-to-the-second lot ageing is not the chosen v1 specification.

website_replacements.headline: EARLY EXITS PAY HOLDERS.
website_replacements.subline: Trading fees fund ETH rewards. Older holdings earn a larger share and pay less to exit.
website_replacements.distribution: Rewards are credited after fee settlement. Claim ETH when available.
website_replacements.holding_age: Each purchase has its own age. Adding tokens preserves existing progress.
website_replacements.transfers: Moving tokens to another wallet is an exit and starts a new holding clock for the received tokens.
website_replacements.calculator: Use actual eligible weighted supply, the quoted amount-specific exit fee, current funded assets and separately labelled volume scenarios. No fixed annual income promise.

required_before_mainnet: Complete Solidity implementation and independent security review
Foundry invariants, fuzzing, rounding and worst-case gas checks
Fork tests of the exact Base pair/router including liquidity, flash swaps and failed fee processing
Chosen seed liquidity, disclosed treasury and verified LP custody
Verified Base Sepolia end-to-end flow followed by a separate authorized mainnet launch
